title: Collaboration & Smart Notes
description: Introducing real-time collaboration features, smart annotations, and the foundation for the 'Git for Data' workflow.
highlights: Smart Notes System with threaded discussions
Real-time collaboration with live cursors and follow mode
Git for Data (Beta) with private mode and diff view

items.title: Smart Notes System
items.description: Add context-aware notes and threaded discussions to any cell in your spreadsheets.
details: Cell Annotations: Add context-aware notes to any cell using the right-click menu
Threaded Discussions: Click on note indicators (amber triangles) to view and reply to threads
Resolution Workflow: Mark notes as resolved to keep track of tasks
Visual Indicators: Indicators for cells with active notes for quick visual scanning

items.title: Real-Time Collaboration
items.description: See what other users are doing in real-time with live cursors and presence tracking.
details: Live Cursors: See where other users are working in real-time
Follow Me Mode: Click on a user's cursor to automatically follow their navigation
Presence Counter: Live count of active users on the dashboard (powered by SurrealDB)

items.title: Git for Data (Beta)
items.description: Work on your data in isolated branches and merge changes when ready.
details: Private Mode: Toggle Private Mode to edit in an isolated branch without affecting the main view
Diff View: Preview changes before merging them back to the main branch
Branching Logic: Implementation of core branching and merging capabilities in the Data Engine

items.title: Performance & Optimization
items.description: Significant performance improvements for large datasets and search operations.
details: Engine Optimization: Verified stable performance with 10,000+ rows
Search & Replace: Optimized search engine for large datasets
SurrealDB Integration: Foundational setup for future real-time features

items.title: Backend Architecture & Stability
items.description: Complete backend migration to SurrealDB v2 with improved authentication and stability.
details: SurrealDB Migration: Complete migration of core database to SurrealDB v2 for scalability
Robust Authentication: Updated WorkOS integration with stable user management
Server Stability: Resolved critical startup issues and improved experimental feature handling
Legacy Compatibility: Added support for legacy endpoints to ensure smooth transition
